title: Georgia consumable-hemp retail
description: Narrows the jurisdiction-neutral core schema to what a Georgia consumable-hemp retailer may lawfully sell: excludes flower/preroll retail sale, applies per-product_form THC mg caps, enforces the total-THC ≤0.3% dry-weight formula, and requires a linked, in-date, publicly reachable, passing Certificate of Analysis (COA) before a Package is profile-valid. Composition is allOf-only over core — this profile restricts, never extends (decision-hemp-interchange-schema-scope). Not legal advice; encoded strictly from the cited primary sources below, per research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449. See rules/README.md for rule IDs and NOT_MODELED.md for what this profile deliberately does not enforce.

citations.title: GA Comp. R. & Regs. 40-32-5-.06
citations.source: Georgia Secretary of State rules portal
citations.covers: per-form THC mg caps, full-panel COA requirement, COA recency/public-availability

citations.title: Ga. Comp. R. & Regs. r. 40-32-5-.01(1)(a)3 (F. 2024-09-11, eff. 2024-10-01)
citations.covers: marijuana products or low THC oil products shall not be sold as consumable hemp (GA-REG-CLASS exclusion)

citations.title: Georgia Senate Bill 494
citations.covers: retail sale ban on hemp flower/leaf (prerolls included); statutory basis for the ≤0.3% total-THC hemp definition

citations.title: O.C.G.A. §§ 2-23-3, 2-23-6.2, 2-23-9.1, 2-23-9.2, 16-12-190, 16-12-200
citations.covers: consumable hemp product definition; retail license; COA recency 'within the last 12 months'; no suggestion of medical cannabis/low THC oil; criminal provisions
